overall-project-health.definition: One rating of a project's condition, calculated by the platform under AHDA's health rules: [[progress.health.GREEN]], [[progress.health.AMBER]], [[progress.health.RED]], or [[progress.health.UNKNOWN]] when it cannot be worked out. It is never entered by hand.

current-live.definition: A figure as it stands now, from the latest work recorded. It can change at any time and has not been reviewed by AHDA.

published-official.definition: A figure AHDA has reviewed and published. It is the official value for its reporting cycle and changes only when the next cycle is published.

historical-snapshot.definition: A figure as it stood on an earlier date, kept so that trends and past reports can be read as they were.

stale.definition: A value whose source says a later report is still outstanding. It is shown as it stood on its as-of date.

coverage.definition: For a total, how many of the eligible projects it counts, and why the others were left out: no data, restricted, or values that cannot be combined.

as-of.definition: The date a figure describes. A figure without one has no value to date.

formal-project-id.definition: The project's official number, issued when AHDA approves its registration. A draft or submitted project has none yet.

governance-profile.definition: The set of rules a project is governed by, chosen at registration. It decides, for example, which fields must be filled in before submission.

participation.definition: Who delivers the project: [[projects.participationMode.AHDA_MANAGED]] or [[projects.participationMode.ENTITY_MANAGED]]. An entity-managed project names the entity, whose users can then see it and answer AHDA's update requests.

owning-sector.definition: The AHDA sector a project belongs to. Sector Managers see and follow the projects of their sectors.

project-workspace.definition: The page a project opens on, with one tab per area: [[projects.workspace.tabs.overview]], [[projects.workspace.tabs.registration]], [[projects.workspace.tabs.progress]], [[projects.workspace.tabs.schedule]] and the others your roles allow.

approval-authority.definition: The decisions a person may take on requests, set by AHDA's approval routing. It can be delegated to someone else, who may then decide only what the person who delegated could decide.

revision.definition: A numbered version of something submitted for review. When a submission is returned, the corrected one is submitted as its next revision; earlier revisions are kept.

reporting-completeness.definition: Whether each project has submitted the progress report due for the current reporting cycle.

update-request.definition: AHDA's request to an external entity for specific information about one of its projects, such as task progress, with a due date.

contribution.definition: An external entity's response to an update request. Once submitted it cannot be changed; AHDA accepts, rejects or returns it for correction.

clean-file.definition: A file the malware check has cleared. Only a clean file can be downloaded or used as evidence.

escalation.definition: Raising an overdue or unresolved item to the next level of authority, so that someone with more authority acts on it.
